notes.title: The Master of the Time Management Ranking Rewards!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44802144/ba630d5869c3b5afe0d7227ac29cfbc290d209b7.png[/img]
[h2]Event Period: 25 February - 31 March 2025 ( GMT )

Prize: Hunky City Digital Postcard Set (PDF)

Rules: Players who reach the top 20 in the Leaderboards by the end of the campaign period will be rewarded. 

Prizes: The names of the top 20 players will be announced at the end of the event.[/h2]
[h3]Winning players please send a mail to service@fymmg.com. 
(Subject: Hunky City Steam Rewards and sign your Steam gamer name and Steam ID in the letter)[/h3]
